fields.name: Nested model
fields.definition: A model property marked `[MapToModel]` whose type is itself a mapped model, such as a shared Address model inside Customer, Store and Vendor. Its mapping attributes extend the parent's parameter and column set: they are flattened into the same parameters or row, not read from a separate result. Nested models may chain to any depth. The Mapper instantiates the nested object when the property is null, settable and default-constructible.
